subject.title: [Feature]: Support for sandbox Docker parameters (--gpus all, --ipc=host)

question: Should OpenClaw expose host IPC for Docker sandboxes, and if so should it be a narrow explicit `sandbox.docker.ipc` break-glass field instead of raw Docker argument passthrough?
rationale: GPU passthrough is already implemented and shipped, while the remaining host IPC/raw-args request changes the sandbox isolation boundary and public config contract.

options.title: Add Narrow Host IPC Field
options.body: Add an explicit opt-in host IPC setting with validation, config hashing, docs, security-audit coverage, and tests while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.

options.title: Reject Host IPC In Core
options.body: Document that host IPC weakens sandbox isolation and leave typed GPU passthrough as the supported high-power Docker path.

options.title: Design Broader Namespace Policy
options.body: Pause implementation until maintainers define one policy for IPC, PID, network namespace joins, capabilities, and other dangerous Docker options.

recommendation.title: Add Narrow Host IPC Field
recommendation.body: Add an explicit opt-in host IPC setting with validation, config hashing, docs, security-audit coverage, and tests while keeping raw Docker args unsupported.
